report.status_line: Critical water shortage after trailer tank rupture and static tank depletion.

concerns.title: Trailer water tank rupture and static tank depletion
concerns.detail: The trailer tank has ruptured, the static tank is reported empty (less than 10 cm), and the loft tank is half-empty. The static tank level is insufficient to refill the loft tank, prompting entry into a critical water contingency plan with supplies expected to run out tomorrow.

concerns.title: Hot water system failure
concerns.detail: Hot water has still not been attained per the engineering report, and the crew has requested additional mitigation strategies.

crew_actions: Execute critical water contingency plan and strict conservation measures.
Monitor remaining volume in the loft tank.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve and dispatch an urgent water resupply.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank ruptured, the static tank is empty, and the half-empty loft tank will run out tomorrow.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or deny the requested EVA for Jan 17th, 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: Crew hydration and safety must be assessed while the habitat is under an acute water contingency.

report.message_to_earth:
STATUS: Habitat status is critical due to an acute water shortage following equipment failure.
WHAT HAPPENED: On 2015-01-16, the trailer tank ruptured, leaving the static tank empty and the loft tank half-empty. Water is projected to run out tomorrow.
WHAT THE CREW IS DOING: The crew has initiated critical water-saving techniques and entered a water contingency plan.
OTHER SYSTEMS: Propane is at 39%, diesel is less than 3/4, but hot water has still not been attained.
REQUEST: Approve and dispatch an immediate emergency water resupply and advise on the proposed Jan 17th EVA.
NEXT UPDATE: The crew will report again tomorrow morning.
